hook: Casting concrete inside flexible fabric molds cuts material needs by 66.7%.

sections.voiceover: Casting concrete inside flexible fabric molds cuts material needs by 66.7%.
sections.visual_cue: Cinematic macro shot of liquid concrete pouring into a flexible textile mold, revealing fluid curved contours under pressure.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep resonant metallic hum fading into pouring concrete fluid sounds.
b_roll: Concrete pouring into flexible textile mold detail
Fabric formwork expanding under wet concrete weight
sections.animation_cue: Text overlay animating in with concrete volume reduction stat

sections.voiceover: In September 2026, Massachusetts Institute of Technology researchers poured concrete beams into fabric formwork. Why did Global North factories see prices soar?
sections.visual_cue: Archival footage of traditional rigid wooden concrete formwork transitioning to computer topology optimization models on screen.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle acoustic room tone with quiet mechanical keyboard clicks.
b_roll: Construction workers assembling heavy wooden beam formwork
Computer monitor displaying structural topology optimization mesh

sections.voiceover: However, sewing fabric molds in the Global North wasn't cheaper, raising production costs by 16% to 55%.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up tracking shot of high-tension industrial sewing machines stitching thick reinforcement fabric seams.
sections.sfx_cue: Sharp rhythmic industrial sewing machine needle clatter.
b_roll: Industrial sewing machine stitching heavy technical fabric
Worker inspecting stitched textile formwork seams
sections.animation_cue: Red cost premium callout box animating over fabric seam close-up
sections.transition_out: Quick flash cut to completed beam

sections.voiceover: Carstensen proved topology optimization cuts concrete volume by 66.7%. High labor turned material savings into a 55% penalty.
sections.visual_cue: Cross-section comparison of a solid rectangular concrete beam versus an organic hollowed-out topology-optimized structural beam.
sections.sfx_cue: Low bass thud marking structural weight comparison.
b_roll: Engineers inspecting cured organic concrete structural beam
Laboratory stress test of topology-optimized concrete element
sections.animation_cue: 3D beam model dissolving non-structural mass to show internal stress lines
sections.transition_out: Slow push in toward structural beam center

sections.voiceover: Researchers published their fabric formwork findings in the Journal of Building Engineering.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of an empty modern automated precast concrete factory floor with motionless machinery.
sections.sfx_cue: Echoing factory ambient air release cut short.
b_roll: Empty modern precast concrete manufacturing facility
Static shot of finished curved concrete beam sitting in warehouse
sections.animation_cue: Fade to black with study citation line
